snippet.title: Dyadem - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
⭐️ - Play Signup for the free Playtest and Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4206930?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announcement

Become the greatest tactician in this love letter to classic handheld SRPGs. It falls to you to forge the bonds of your Prince's followers, develop their skills, and shape their strategies as you fight to reclaim your homeland and save the world.

If you are reading this far you are actually a legend! ❤️
